notes:
Six cases, cut down from fourteen by an adversarial review. What was dropped and why: three static lint checks (user-invocable, when-not-to-use, no-duplicated-shell) are authoring hygiene that passes identically on both versions — they belong in a generic linter across ALL skills, not bolted onto this one; SHA-existence was subsumed by nothing-uncommitted; due-done scheduling belongs to checkpoint.sh, not to /update's output. Two original cases were removed as tautological (they only checked that a template field exists, which any model given the template satisfies forever). Two pairs were merged: error+categories, and keep-the-facts+invent-nothing — the latter because as separate cases a degenerate 'dump everything when there is content, say nothing when there is not' strategy passes both without ever exercising selection.

Scope limit, stated rather than hidden: this suite proves the skill CAN produce a good entry on curated cases. It does NOT gate every real run — that is checkpoint.sh's `verify`, which runs on every /update. Two named requirements stay uncovered here by choice: the #architettura tag and worktree provenance, both checkable by `verify` at zero cost.

VARIANZA MISURATA (2026-08-11): `nothing-left-silently-on-disk` dà 3/4 su ripetizioni identiche — un singolo campione mente. Un rosso isolato su questa suite va riprodotto prima di toccare la skill: due volte su due, stanotte, il rosso era del test e non della skill, e una terza era solo rumore. Leggere sempre la risposta del modello (`_eval_output.txt` per la suite comportamentale) prima di 'aggiustare'. Casi marcati flaky qui sotto con `stability`.

tasks.intent: Update. Sessione tosta: ho proposto un layer di cattura che esisteva già e mi hai corretto; sono rimasto venti minuti su un assert che falliva per un confounder; il push su main è rifiutato dai required check; e abbiamo abbandonato l'ipotesi 'team vs single mode'.
tasks.context_excerpt: One session carrying four distinct non-progress events: an error the founder corrected, a loop, a blocker, and a superseded decision. The entry must tag all four AND name the actual thing in each — a templated 'ho fatto un errore, regola: stare attenti' has the required shape with none of the content, and shape is what an LLM games most easily. The judge therefore checks that the specific nouns of this session appear next to the tags.

tasks.context_excerpt: Code changed. The Files field must let a reader reach the change months later without re-reading the diff: path, the symbol touched, and why. The symbol matters because Serena navigates by symbol — that is where the log and the code graph meet. This is the axis the blind A/B judgment separated most sharply (9 vs 4).

tasks.intent: Update. Sweep sicurezza: 12 pattern su working tree e 104 commit, trovato un leak reale (due nomi persona) pubblico da 6 settimane; repo portato a privato — 79 cloni ma solo 4 view e 0 fork. Girati 5 branch di real-test, tutti verdi. Sessione di 4 ore, 85 chiamate bash, 32 write, 3 letture di CLAUDE.md, indice a 3802 doc.
tasks.context_excerpt: Numbers that decide something (the leak, the 6-week exposure, and above all 79 clones AGAINST 4 views, which is what says the traffic was automated and not people) must survive WITH their comparison and their conclusion. Numbers that decide nothing (bash calls, writes, doc count, session length) must not appear. Keeping everything passes a naive fidelity check while destroying the compression the skill exists for; keeping the count without the comparison leaves the reader to re-derive the risk in three weeks. The old format had nowhere to put a 'so what', so it fails on the conclusion, not on the count.

tasks.intent: Update. Lezione di oggi: un denylist che non blocca è peggio di nessun denylist, perché sposta la vigilanza sull'automatismo.
tasks.context_excerpt: Two surfaces, opposite rules. The archive (lessons.md) is append-only and gets written freely — a lesson waiting for approval dies with the context. The apex (CLAUDE.md, rules/) is paid for in every session of every repo and is only ever reached through pol-apex-curate, which proposes and lets the human write. An /update that promotes to the apex on its own is the failure this case exists to catch.

tasks.intent: Update. Ho solo riletto due doc e non ho cambiato niente.
tasks.context_excerpt: The counterweight to a format that rewards Key context: a format that rewards a field will produce that field even when there is nothing to put in it. A quiet session must produce a short honest entry with no manufactured decision, discovery or error. Failing this case means the skill has learned to fill boxes.

tasks.intent: Update. Sistemato il resolver del root e aggiunto il gate; siamo su feat/resolver-fix, non su main.
tasks.context_excerpt: The non-negotiable for a system whose entire value is persistence: after the run the entry is either committed, or the run says out loud that the commit was deferred and why. Silence is the measured failure mode — 74 journal files uncommitted across four repos on 2026-08-08, and 46% of one repo's recent entries never reaching any ref. On a feature branch the correct outcome is a declared deferral, never a quiet write to disk.
